lxc_e114dfc27a40638c.text: Snowboarding is a snow sport with one board.

lxc_9127f5d16edc87a8.text: Riders can enjoy it for fun or compete in events.

lxc_0b20750e2fa96d04.text: Snowboarding is a recreational and competitive sport.

lxc_1c2489b812084a9f.text: A rider goes down a snow-covered surface while standing on a snowboard.

lxc_2eda7d9e0ce55d1d.text: The snowboard is the single board under the rider’s feet.

lxc_f5d14bcbe6e39ec2.text: A skier uses two separate skis and usually faces forward.

lxc_34c39cee29115ad8.text: A snowboarder stands sideways on one board.

lxc_e28b65f05a4d85f9.text: Both feet are fixed to that board.

lxc_35af06b3cf0b0db9.text: One board and a sideways body position are important parts of snowboarding.

lxc_0f35c44087a91920.text: Modern snowboarding equipment usually has three main things.

lxc_48f3775d4123b48c.text: These are a snowboard, special boots, and bindings.

lxc_a16a78624229f427.text: Bindings are the parts that lock the boots to the board.

lxc_997d83401ba5990d.text: Snowboard bindings are not made to open automatically during a fall.

lxc_ea54a72303235904.text: The locked snowboard is connected to a lower risk of knee injuries than skiing.

lxc_8a291682433523ee.text: On the source page, 15% of snowboard injuries are knee injuries.

lxc_d985d3da20201a2b.text: For skiing, 45% of all injuries are knee injuries.

lxc_bd6670a151a28339.text: A snowboarder can put either foot first on the board.

lxc_084ee9c532891613.text: The word stance means the way the rider stands.

lxc_5d14bc3487d49be5.text: In a regular stance, the left foot is first.

lxc_24101f1b435f7fd1.text: In a goofy stance, the right foot is first.

lxc_9e4fffa6cb112e4e.text: Both feet still stay fixed to the same snowboard.

lxc_134e402ce755c207.text: The difference is only which foot comes first.

lxc_0e6d7e0ae52303ed.text: In both stances, the rider stands sideways.

lxc_78fcf711e1d12c02.text: This is different from the usual forward-facing position in skiing.

lxc_359741557e5fa835.text: Snowboarding was first developed in the United States in 1965.

lxc_b897f9741d174ab9.text: In Muskegon, Michigan, Sherman Poppen fastened two skis together.

lxc_d7afac584fc1aed3.text: His wife, Nancy, named the snow toy the snurfer.

lxc_8c21356f803990f8.text: The snurfer was an early snow toy made from two joined skis.

lxc_fabc0722543f7de8.text: More than half a million snurfers were sold in 1966 alone.

lxc_d035ad5b447a75a9.text: A manufacturer sold about one million of them during the next ten years.

lxc_250a1e057b1969cb.text: The sport continued to develop after the snurfer.

lxc_8cb0219bdc361efb.text: In 1977, Jake Burton Carpenter started Burton Snowboards in Londonderry, Vermont.

lxc_77542726af5291af.text: It was a company for snowboards.

lxc_90d95feccd5768b7.text: Snowboarding later became part of a large international sports event.

lxc_6bc8b21008fa7540.text: It has been in the Winter Olympic Games since 1998.

lxc_3a527ac6c1a0b987.text: Today, it can still be recreational, which means people do it for enjoyment.

lxc_e0bdf3927726d0f4.text: It can also be competitive, with riders taking part in sports events.

lxc_f860e8bb1a3958f9.text: Niseko United is a real place for skiing and snowboarding in Japan.

lxc_e81137f85a8b4604.text: It has four resorts on one mountain, Niseko Annupuri.

lxc_ce5bac5272a41215.text: The mountain is 1,308 meters high and is 100 kilometers south of Sapporo.

lxc_e1a8af57be80429e.text: Its snow has a clear source, change, and result.

lxc_d2282230b100da2e.text: Seasonal winds come from the Eurasian continent.

lxc_637180b6eba97e37.text: They pick up moisture over warm currents in the Sea of Japan.

lxc_375c65973d0f0960.text: The resort page says the result is very dry, light powder.

lxc_c1e685a7138c5d6f.text: Riders of all abilities can use fresh powder or smooth, prepared runs there.
